name: Batch-Cook Clean Meals
equipment: A large pot, sheet pan, and several containers
instructions: Dedicate one session a week to cooking multiple proteins, grains, and vegetables in parallel to build the week's meals.
Keep components separate rather than fully plated meals, so you can mix and match through the week without getting bored.
Cool everything before sealing containers, and eat refrigerated batch-cooked food within about 4 days.
Watch today's video for a full walkthrough of cooking many healthy meals in one session.
